items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a rational map from a Noetherian Nagata surface over a base into a proper scheme over that base becomes a morphism after normalizing and performing a sequence of normalized blowups in closed points (statement lines 1389-1402). The proof (proof lines 1403-1411) produces a proper modification and dominates it by normalized blowups. H2: a complete two step reduction.
